newsitem.title: USA: Longs Drug Stores sets stock split.
newsitem.headline: Longs Drug Stores sets stock split.

text.p: Longs Drug Stores Corp said Tuesday its board of directors have approved a two-for-one stock split.
The stock split will be in the form of a stock dividend to shareholders of record December 3, payable January 10, 1997.
"Our goal is to keep the liquidity of Longs' stock high and maintain the widest possible pool of individual and institutional investors," said President Steve Roath.
"The increase in our shares outstanding and reduction in price per share will help meet that goal," he added.
Earlier Longs reported profits of $9.4 million, or $0.48 a share, for the third quarter compared to net income of $8.8 million, or $0.44 a share, in the comparable year-ago period.
